svg.title: Squinch: section along the diagonal · close-up in context
svg.desc: Section along the diagonal of a square domed bay, with a round close-up of the squinch: stepped courses of masonry corbelled out from the corner up to the ring the dome rests on. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: WHOLE BAY · SECTION ALONG THE DIAGONAL
CLOSE-UP · ×4 · EIGHT CORBELLED COURSES FROM CORNER TO RING
SMALL ARCH BUILT ACROSS A CORNER TO CARRY A DOME
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
